51392316.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to EED (unknown origin) by surface plasmon resonance analysis

original_paragraph.SPR Analysis: Extensive biophysical evaluation confirmed the characterization of 74 (A-395) as an EED-binding ligand that disrupts interaction with H3K27. Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) experiments gave K_D = 1.5 nM of 74 against EED, and fluorescence thermal shift showed a clear shift in EED melting temperature in the presence of 74, in contrast to the negative control 75 which did not affect the EED melting temperature. X-ray crystallization of 74 bound to EED (ΔEED, residues 77–441) showed a number of notable features (Figure 24). Most interestingly, binding of 74 induced significant conformational changes of the H3K27me3-binding pocket of EED to accommodate ligand binding. A new enclosure composed of several aromatic side chains forms a new binding pocket for the 74 central pyrrolidine core.
